  • Supporting early operations and transferring outstanding actions and ongoing responsibilities to the relevant teams.

You will bring substantial experience delivering complex projects, operational mobilisation, service transitions or major change initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
 
You can turn competing requirements into a clear delivery plan, build commitment across business functions and make sound decisions when priorities shift.
 
You will also bring:
  • Strong project governance skills, including integrated planning, risk management, assurance and executive reporting.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and influencing stakeholders across an organisation.
  • Financial and commercial capability, including budget management, forecasting, procurement and supplier coordination.
  • Clear communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
  • Practical knowledge of WHS, privacy, records management and operational compliance.
  • A relevant tertiary qualification or an equivalent combination of expertise and senior project experience.
  • A current Queensland driver licence and willingness to complete a National Police Check.
Experience in community housing, human services, property development, construction handover or asset management would be valuable. Experience opening new residential properties or services, implementing systems or managing data migration would also be well regarded.

  • Full-time hours, 38 hours per week.
